module purpose: neorv32_twi takes bus writes into a control register (enable, prescaler select, clock divider, clock-stretch enable) and into an 11-bit command queue (TX FIFO sub-unit); an engine fetches each queued command and drives twi_sda_o and twi_scl_o in four timed phases per bit, samples twi_sda_i and twi_scl_i, writes each completed 9-bit word into an RX FIFO sub-unit, returns control, status and received words on bus reads, and raises irq_o when enabled, idle and the command queue is empty.

use-case flows.value: control settings (enable, prescaler select, clock divider, clock-stretch enable) taken from bus write data when addr(2) = '0'
command word (data byte, acknowledge bit, 2-bit command) pushed into the TX FIFO by a bus write when addr(2) = '1'
command fetch: the idle engine pops the next command on a tick and loads its command bits and data word
bit-timing tick produced from the selected prescaler enable and the divider compare
four-phase bit sequencing, frozen by the clock-stretch hold
line levels driven per engine state and phase, data word shifted out and sampled in, bit counting and completion
completed 9-bit word written into the RX FIFO
interrupt request and status bits (sensed line levels, TX full, RX available, busy)
control settings and FIFO depth returned on a control-register read; received word popped and returned on a data-register read
rstn_i clears enable, prescaler, divider, response, irq, timing, phase and engine registers; a cleared enable clears both FIFOs, holds the timing and phase logic and idles the engine
